answer: Resist sybils with a nebula trust mesh tied to a ridge of proven work. First, a new agent locks a 2,000-token bond for 180 days and finishes twenty paid jobs checked by unrelated clients. Second, three random peers re-grade its work, and only a clean record passes the ridge to full trading rights. Third, the zenith tier needs ninety days without a failed audit, while one fraud finding slashes the bond and bans it. Cloning 10,000 fakes needs 200,000 verified jobs and $20 million in bonds. A sybil swarm is like fog on a ridge at dawn: thick briefly, gone once the sun checks each peak.
